Name: Valley Drone
Author: wlxproject
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2B53A]VALLEY DRONE[/color][/b][/size]
[i][color=#3EC6F0]Let a little quadcopter water your crops for you.[/color][/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]About[/color][/b][/size]
Tired of walking every row with a watering can? Buy a farm drone once and it flies over your farm, watering every dry crop tile by tile while you get on with your day.

[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Drone menu[/b] - press [b]F8[/b] in a loaded save to open it.[/*]
[*][b]One-time purchase[/b] - buy the drone for [b]5,000g[/b]. Ownership is saved per save file.[/*]
[*][b]Water the field[/b] - the drone visits every unwatered crop on your farm and waters it.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic watering[/b] - turn it on and the drone launches by itself every morning.[/*]
[*][b]Adjustable speed[/b] - cycle between 2x and 8x (default 4x).[/*]
[*][b]Nice feedback[/b] - animated drone with a shadow, falling water drops and splashes, watering sounds, a "Drone: done/total" counter on screen and a sound when it finishes.[/*]
[*]Keep playing while it works; the game doesn't pause.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]How to use[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Load your save and press [b]F8[/b].[/*]
[*]Buy the drone (5,000g).[/*]
[*]Press [b]F8[/b] again and choose [b]Water the field[/b], or turn on [b]Automatic watering[/b].[/*]
[*]Use the speed button to make the drone faster or slower.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]Configuration[/color][/b][/size]
A [b]config.json[/b] file is created in the mod folder the first time you run the game with the mod.
[list]
[*][b]MenuKey[/b] (default [b]F8[/b]) - key that opens the drone menu.[/*]
[*][b]Price[/b] (default [b]5000[/b]) - cost of the drone in gold.[/*]
[*][b]Speed[/b] (default [b]4[/b]) - drone flight speed. Also changeable in the menu.[/*]
[*][b]Auto[/b] (default [b]false[/b]) - automatic watering every morning. Also changeable in the menu.[/*]
[/list]Changes made in the menu are saved to config.json when the game saves.

[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Made for single-player. Multiplayer is not tested.[/*]
[*]Doesn't patch game code, so conflicts with other mods should be rare.[/*]
[*]Safe to uninstall at any time; it adds no items to your save.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]Known issues / notes[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The in-game menu and messages are currently in Turkish only.[/*]
[*]Only the main farm is watered. The greenhouse, Ginger Island and garden pots are not.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#F2B53A]FAQ[/color][/b][/size]
[b][color=#6BBF59]Does it water the greenhouse?[/color][/b]
No, only crops on your main farm.

[b][color=#6BBF59]Can I change the price or the key?[/color][/b]
Yes, edit [b]Price[/b] and [b]MenuKey[/b] in config.json.

[b][color=#6BBF59]Is this a cheat?[/color][/b]
It's a convenience mod. It costs 5,000g by default, and you can raise the price in the config.
